additions: A hockey puck slides with constant velocity on frictionless ice. It has nonzero momentum. Does maintaining that momentum require a net force? Explain using the relationship between net force and the rate of change of momentum.

An empty cart and a loaded cart experience the same constant net force for the same time. (a) Compare their changes in momentum. (b) Compare their changes in velocity. Explain how your answers agree with both forms of Newton’s second law.

A ball moves in a circle at constant speed. (a) Is its momentum constant? (b) Does a net force act on it? Explain using the relationship between force and momentum, and identify the direction of the net force.
